user_prompt: We need visibility into how our daily supplier payment obligations will impact our available cash balance hour-by-hour, so our treasury team can coordinate with our banks on same-day funding needs before we hit our minimum operating cash threshold—right now we're manually pulling payment schedules from three different systems and it's causing us to request emergency credit lines that cost us fees.

steps.step_name: Integrate and consolidate daily supplier payment schedules from three different systems into a single unified data source

Build a real-time cash flow visibility tool that projects available cash balance hour-by-hour based on payment obligations, with alerts when approaching minimum operating cash threshold to enable proactive coordination with banks for same-day funding

intent_resolver.reason: The user's request is for a treasury/cash flow forecasting capability that integrates supplier payment data across systems for real-time cash visibility and liquidity management—none of the registered skills cover financial planning, cash flow analysis, or treasury operations.
